{{Quote|To make things worse, when I step out the door of the hotel, I'm accosted by a Barabel mugger.|Siro Simito, report on the Dahvil-Fodro Hyperspace Promenade|<ref name="CRO">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref>}}
A '''Barabel male''' resided on the celestial body [[Fait d'Fait]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] was a mugger, and [[Gender/Legends|he]] once unsuccessfully attempted to accost the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Racer/Legends|racer]] [[Siro Simito]] during the latter's visit to a Fait d'Fait [[City/Legends|city]].<ref name="CRO" />
